test_title: SSC CGL 2021 Tier-I (Held On : 21 April 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: The 61st Amendment to the Constitution of India _________.

options.text: exempted Arunachal Pradesh from reservation for Scheduled Castes in Panchayati Raj institutions
restricted the size of council of ministers to 15% of the number of legislative members
reduced the age for voting from 21 to 18 years

solution:
The correct answer is to **reduce** __**the age for voting from 21 to 18 years.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The 61st Constitutional Amendment Act, 1989 of the Constitution of India** lowered the voting age of elections to the Lok Sabha and to the Legislative Assemblies of States.
 
• It reduces the age from **21 years to 18 years**.
 
• **61st Constitution Amendment Act, 1988:**
 
 
• The Sixty-first Amendment act of the Constitution of India, officially known as The Constitution Act, 1988, lowered the age of elections to the Lok Sabha and to the Legislative Assemblies of States from 21 years to 18 years.
 
• This Act was a result of providing amendments to **Article 326** of the constitution, which concerns elections to the Lok Sabha and the assemblies.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Lok Sabha:**

 
 
• It is a temporary body and can be dissolved after every 5 years.
 
• It is also known as the House of People and the lower house of Parliament.
 
• The Lok Sabha has a seating capacity of 550.
 
• Actual Strength: 543. (elected: 543).
 
• Speaker: Om Birla.
 
 
 
• **Legislative Assemblies of States:**
 
 
• It is the legislative body in the State and Union Territories of India and is dissolved after every 5 years.
 
• Maximum Strength: 500.
 
• Minimum Strength: 60(except Goa, Sikkim, Mizoram, and Puducherry).
